issue_request: FHIR-17716 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking that StructureMap mapping-language cast() support all base datatypes, specifically noting that string casting worked but boolean and possibly other casts did not.
initial_application: No source-history commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17716 was found. Later comments on the Jira say the issue was an old tooling issue and ask that remaining defects be raised in the HL7 FHIR IG Publisher tracker. Nearby R5 mapping-language commits for FHIR-22774, FHIR-27140, and FHIR-20846 updated the specification text around implicit conversions, cast type names, and FHIRPath integration.
additional_context: StructureMap is active in the current build configuration. The current mapping-language page says StructureMap execution requires FHIRPath, defines cast as converting one type to another with FHIR as the default namespace for type names, and states that underlying source/target type systems may define required implicit conversions with FHIRPath implicit conversions as the FHIR example. FHIR-17711 is the same old tooling/support family but broader, and FHIR-54484 is a later unresolved transform-function documentation request, so neither was decided here.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current FHIR-core source already conveys the relevant specification-level cast/type semantics, and the seed's residual issue belongs in implementation tooling rather than core specification prose.
